strongVs.note: Nether Ward punishes constant spell/Rearm casting
Nether Ward punishes Ball Lightning/Remnant spam
Decrepify on the target ally blanks physical crits

weakVs.note: Mind Flare/Mana Burn punish Pugna's large mana pool
Silences stop Life Drain and Decrepify saves

notes: Tower-razing nuker whose Nether Blast takes buildings fast (Oblivion Savant adds spell amp per tower). Decrepify saves allies from physical burst or amplifies magic combos, and Nether Ward punishes spell-spammers. He is very fragile and dies to invisible or mana-burn gankers and silences.

strongVs.note: Psi Blades split onto clones, and Refraction blocks Poof instances
Refraction absorbs Burning Spear attacks in lane

weakVs.note: Chakram and Whirling Death ticks strip Refraction, and Reactive Armor soaks her burst
Quill Spray instances strip Refraction
Corrosive Haze armor loss and True Sight on a low-armor carry
Static Link drains her attack damage in lane

notes: Refraction-shielded burst carry, now mostly played pos1, who snowballs off early kills, towers and Roshan. Psi Blades shred illusions and summons. She collapses against damage over time that strips Refraction (Bristleback, Venomancer, Timbersaw), armor reduction and True Sight.

strongVs.note: Viper Strike breaks Berserker's Blood, and Poison Attack wins the ranged lane
Viper Strike breaks Bristleback's damage reduction
Viper Strike breaks Dispersion and Desolate
Break disables Reactive Armor

notes: Strong lane bully whose Viper Strike (2 charges) breaks passives (Bristleback, Spectre, PA, Huskar, Timbersaw), while Nethertoxin zones attack-speed carries. Viper is strong early and mid game, falls off late, and its single-target damage struggles against illusion carries (PL, Naga).

strongVs.note: Moon Glaives bounce through illusions

weakVs.note: Duel isolates a low-armor carry

notes: Fast-farming Moon Glaives carry who clears waves, punishes illusion and summon heroes, and spikes mid-game with Manta and BKB. She has low armor and HP, needs frontline, and gets jumped by Legion Commander, PA and Bristleback.

weakVs.note: Break shuts off Dragon Blood armor/regen

notes: Tanky pusher whose Elder Dragon Form now evolves by level (corrosive, then splash, then frost slow) to take towers and win extended fights while shrugging off physical damage. He is good against illusions and melee, and weak to break (Viper), pure damage (Timbersaw) and kiting.

strongVs.note: Shallow Grave denies Duel kills

weakVs.note: Ice Blast blocks Shadow Wave and all healing on Graved targets
Doom silences Dazzle so Grave can't be cast

notes: Save support whose Shallow Grave negates kills from burst, Duel or Rupture, while Shadow Wave heals and Weave swings armor for physical lineups. He must stay alive and unsilenced. Ice Blast, Doom and Global Silence hard-counter him.

strongVs.note: Hookshot/Power Cogs trap an immobile backliner

weakVs.note: Rage ignores Hookshot/Battery Assault disables

notes: Pick-off initiator whose Hookshot and Power Cogs isolate squishy backliners early, played at both pos4 and pos5. He needs follow-up damage and is weak against carries with spell immunity or dispels (Lifestealer Rage, Jugg spin, Slark Dark Pact).

weakVs.note: Mana Break drains Pulse Nova upkeep

notes: Leshrac destroys towers with Diabolic Edict and fights with Pulse Nova AoE, which makes him one of the best at fast pushes and clearing illusions and summons. He is mana-hungry, so mana burn (Anti-Mage, Nyx) and silences counter him.

strongVs.note: Sprout isolates an immobile ranged carry for global ganks

weakVs.note: Timbersaw clears Sprout/forest and wins the lane
Global Charge punishes lone split-pushing and TPs

notes: Global split-pusher, now mostly a pos1, whose Teleportation and treants (which feed Spirit of the Forest damage) create map pressure and fast tower damage, while Sprout sets up picks. Global or fast gankers (Spirit Breaker) punish him when he is caught alone, and Timbersaw clears his trees.

strongVs.note: Feast %-max-HP damage shreds tanks

weakVs.note: Ice Blast shuts off Feast lifesteal
Doom pierces Rage debuff immunity and blocks healing

notes: Rage-immune melee carry whose Feast shreds high-HP tanks, and Infest lets him ride allies (Spirit Breaker, Batrider) into fights. Anti-heal, disables that pierce debuff immunity (Doom, Beastmaster) and pure damage counter him.

strongVs.note: Ion Shell melts illusions
Ion Shell hits clustered clones

notes: Offlane enabler whose Ion Shell wins lanes and deletes illusions and summons, while Surge speeds cores and Vacuum into Wall of Replica sets up AoE wombos. He needs AoE follow-up and relies on spells, so silences and mana burn blunt him.

strongVs.note: Infernal Shred pierces armor

weakVs.note: Track reveals Skeleton Walk
Corrosive Haze reveals and strips armor
Lightning Bolt/Thundergod's Wrath give True Sight

notes: Invisible armor-piercing carry (Infernal Shred, Searing Arrows, Skeleton Walk archers) who picks off isolated supports. He is fragile, and detection and reveals (Track, Corrosive Haze, Zeus) hard-counter him.

strongVs.note: Guardian Angel nullifies physical crits

notes: Anti-physical protector whose Guardian Angel is now a 700-radius aura around him with no linger, so he must stand in the fight. Repel grants debuff immunity, and Purification and Hammer heal. He is useless against magic-heavy lineups, and silences and anti-heal counter him.

strongVs.note: Untouchable slows attack speed, and Impetus kites
Untouchable guts melee attack speed

notes: Enchantress has long-range Impetus poke, heals and Untouchable, which cripples melee right-click carries. She needs a frontline to hide behind and is vulnerable to magic burst and mobile divers.

strongVs.note: Life Break and %-HP spears chunk high-HP strength heroes

weakVs.note: Viper Strike breaks Berserker's Blood
Ice Blast stops all healing and regen
Heartstopper %HP drain and Reaper's Scythe punish his low-HP style
Culling Blade executes low-HP Huskar

notes: Low-HP berserker who dominates melee and strength lanes and dives with Life Break. He needs save supports (Dazzle, Oracle). He is banned a lot but does poorly when picked into prepared drafts. He falls off late, and break, anti-heal, Necrophos and Culling Blade hard-counter him.

strongVs.note: Crippling Fear silence and Void catch blinkers

notes: Night-time ganker whose Void and Crippling Fear silence catch mobile spellcasters, while Dark Ascension gives flying vision and Midnight Feast sustains him. He wants early fights and night timings, and is weak against tanky or pure-damage offlaners and when games go late.

weakVs.note: Pulse Nova/Edict wipe spiderlings

notes: Spiderling lane-dominator and relentless tower/split pusher who wins early and must end games. Hard-countered by AoE that farms spiders (Leshrac, TA, Luna, Timbersaw, Dark Seer).

strongVs.note: Track grants True Sight through Cloak and Dagger
Track reveals Skeleton Walk
Track reveals Shukuchi

weakVs.note: Zeus spells reveal and burst Shadow Walk

notes: Roaming invisible pos4 whose Track grants True Sight, pays team gold and marks targets for global or fast gankers. Big Game Hunter adds kill gold on the enemy's three highest net-worth heroes. He is one of the best counters to invisible heroes, and weak to reveals and tanky melee.

weakVs.note: Track reveals Shukuchi

notes: Elusive skirmisher with Shukuchi and Time Lapse, whose Swarm armor reduction, Threads of Fate and Geminate Attack burst immobile targets. He is hard to pin down but flimsy, and True Sight and reveals (Track, Corrosive Haze) counter him.

strongVs.note: Macropyre and Dual Breath hit every illusion

notes: Lane-bully pushing support whose Liquid Fire and Liquid Frost melt towers, while Ice Path and Macropyre zone teamfights and clear illusions. Jakiro is slow and immobile, which divers and invisible gankers punish.

weakVs.note: Rubick steals Flaming Lasso

synergies.note: Relocate, Tether and Lasso drag targets across the map

notes: Batrider uses Blink, Firefly and Flaming Lasso to drag one key target into his team, which gives elite picks and initiation, and Sticky Napalm adds lane pressure. He needs follow-up, and Rubick stealing Lasso and silences punish him.

weakVs.note: Ion Shell deletes the creep army

notes: Creep-army micro support for early pushes, with global Hand of God heals and Zealot and Penitence utility. He must end early. AoE (Ion Shell, Leshrac) deletes his creeps, and Chen himself falls off late.

weakVs.note: Viper Strike breaks Dispersion
Scepter Doom breaks Dispersion/Desolate

notes: Global hyper-carry whose Haunt joins every fight. Shadow Step is a long-range illusion gap-closer, Dispersion reflects burst and innate Desolate adds pure damage. She is slow early, and break (Viper, Doom scepter) and lane pressure are her main weaknesses.

strongVs.note: Ice Blast stops Berserker's Blood regen and heals
Ice Blast blocks Shadow Wave and all healing on Graved targets
Ice Blast shuts off Chemical Rage regen

notes: Global Ice Blast shuts off healing and shatters low-HP targets. Cold Feet and Ice Vortex give long-range zoning, and Bone Chill saps Strength. He is the go-to counter-pick against regen and heal heroes, and fragile against divers.

strongVs.note: Doom silences Ball Lightning

weakVs.note: Rubick steals Doom
Single-target ult vs an illusion army

notes: Tanky offlaner (occasionally safelane) whose Doom dispels, silences and blocks healing on the enemy's key hero, and Scepter adds Break. He farms fast with Devour. He is one of the best answers to cores that rely on spells or saves, but his single-target ult is weak against illusion carries.

weakVs.note: Untouchable guts Ursa's attack speed
Winter's Curse turns Ursa on her allies

notes: Early Roshan and single-target melee shredder (Fury Swipes, Enrage, HP-scaling Maul). She wants to end mid-game. Kiting, evasion, Untouchable, Guardian Angel and Winter's Curse counter her.

strongVs.note: Global Charge punishes split-pushing

synergies.note: Infest on Spirit Breaker during Charge

notes: Global Charge of Darkness ganker who punishes split-pushers and immobile backliners, and Greater Bash chain-stuns. He is best early to mid game, and weak against illusions, break and saves on the charge target.

strongVs.note: Flak Cannon hits every illusion

synergies.note: Tether with Flak Cannon is a classic pairing

notes: Gyrocopter's Flak Cannon and Rocket Barrage deal multi-target damage that farms fast and wrecks illusions and summons. He has no escape, so Duel, PA and mobile gankers jump him. Io and Gyro are a classic combo.

weakVs.note: Ice Blast shuts off Chemical Rage regen

notes: Alchemist is the fastest farmer in the game. Chemical Rage regen makes him a durable mid-game fighter, and he can melt Aghanim's Scepters into allies. He needs space early, and anti-heal (Ice Blast, Heartstopper) and pure damage cut his sustain.

strongVs.note: EMP burns Mana Shield

weakVs.note: Mind Flare scales with Invoker's large mana pool

notes: Level-scaling spellcaster with global Sun Strike, Tornado-Meteor-Blast teamfight burst and EMP against mana heroes. He needs levels and space, and mana burn, Doom and gap-closers punish him.

strongVs.note: Global Silence/Last Word stop Ball Lightning
Global Silence prevents the Black Hole engage

notes: Global Silence and Last Word shut down spell-reliant heroes and Blink initiators without BKB, and Silencer steals Int over the game. He has little impact against right-click lineups that ignore silence.

strongVs.note: Arcane Orb pure damage ignores Berserker's Blood magic resistance

weakVs.note: Mana Break/Void punish a mana-scaling hero

notes: Mana-scaling mid whose Arcane Orb pure damage melts high-HP heroes. Objurgation's barrier and Astral Imprisonment save him or his allies, and Sanity's Eclipse punishes low-mana teams. Mana burn and silences counter him.

weakVs.note: Counter Helix and Call kill wolves

notes: Offlane wolf-pack tower pusher and Shapeshift ganker who must convert early pressure into buildings. He falls off if stalled, and AoE that kills wolves (Axe, Leshrac) blunts him.

weakVs.note: Doom before Primal Split stops the ultimate

notes: Primal Split initiator whose Earth tank, Storm's Cyclone and Dispel, and Fire damage let him dictate fights, and his stances work while silenced. He is very micro-intensive, and Doom or silence before Split shuts him down.

strongVs.note: Demonic Purge dispels Aphotic Shield

notes: Disruption saves allies and sets up skillshots, and Demonic Purge dispels enemy buffs and slows. Shadow Demon combos with point-target nukers (Split Earth, Sun Strike, Light Strike) and is fragile against divers.

weakVs.note: Doom on druid or bear ends his fight

notes: Lone Druid's innate Spirit Bear and Entangle root give lane dominance that snowballs into tower pressure and split-pushing, and he is a top-tier pick or ban in pro. He is micro-heavy, and Doom, Axe or Winter's Curse on the bear or the druid ruins fights.

weakVs.note: Counter Helix and Call punish Phantasm illusions
Echo Slam scales with illusions

notes: Reality Rift, Chaos Bolt and crit illusions burst a single target in seconds. Chaos Knight is a strong mid-game diver, and AoE illusion killers (Axe, Earthshaker, Leshrac) punish Phantasm.

weakVs.note: Echo Slam and Aftershock hit all clones, and if one dies, all die

notes: Multi-body ganker who bursts with Earthbind and Poof and farms and split-pushes everywhere, and his clones now copy his items. If one clone dies they all die, so AoE (Earthshaker, Leshrac, TA, Ember) hard-counters him.

strongVs.note: Overgrowth root disables Blink

weakVs.note: Timbersaw destroys trees and deals pure damage

notes: Overgrowth's AoE root stops blinks and escapes. Living Armor and Leech Seed sustain the team, and Nature's Guise lets him roam invisibly. He was one of the most contested pos5 heroes of 7.41d-e before the 7.41f nerfs. Timbersaw and debuff-immune carries blunt him.
Unkillable lane support with Multicast Fireblast stuns and Bloodlust for attack-speed cores. He is strong early, has low late impact, and is weak to pure damage and silence.

Lane bully who steals Strength with Decay, with Tombstone zone control and a Flesh Golem frontline for early fights. He is a heavily contested pos5 who also flexes to offlane. Tombstone combos with trapping ults (Arena, Kinetic Field). He falls off late.

strongVs.note: Steals Black Hole
Steals Reverse Polarity
Steals Flaming Lasso

synergies.note: Telekinesis landing spot guarantees Split Earth

notes: Flexible pos4 with Telekinesis for peel and setup, and a Spell Steal that turns enemy teamfight ultimates (Black Hole, RP, Ravage, Echo Slam, Lasso) against them. He is squishy, and divers and invisible gankers punish him.

strongVs.note: Glimpse returns blinked heroes, and Static Storm silences
Glimpse undoes Ball Lightning, and Static Storm silences

notes: Glimpse and Kinetic Field trap mobile and blink heroes, and Static Storm silences whole teams. Disruptor is excellent against escape-reliant cores and fragile against divers and debuff-immune carries.
